summary: Behavior-preserving explanation-enrichment integration of 115E's Decision Evaluation with the Repository Transition Validator: same decisions, better explanations. TransitionResult gains one new, backward-compatible field, explanation: EvaluationResult | None = None; the validator's own verdict-computing logic (113U's checks/violations/blocking branching) is unchanged, line for line -- only the three return statements now also pass explanation=explanation. Added build_evidence_from_repository_state(state) -> EvidenceCollection, mapping already-computed RepositoryState fields into 115C Evidence items reusing 115D's own Evidence IDs, so 115E's invariant evaluators run completely unmodified; no new Git/filesystem/subprocess/runtime I/O. Fixed a real bug found while designing the adapter: evaluate_canonical_promotion_eligibility now resolves NOT_APPLICABLE, not a misleading automatic FAIL, when only one of its two required inputs is present. Verified behavior-preserving: all 36 pre-existing test_repository_transition_validator.py tests pass unmodified; 32 new regression tests re-run 12 representative 113U scenarios with identical verdicts; the real pcae phase complete / pcae task finish --commit lifecycle integration test suites pass completely unmodified, proving CLI output is unaffected. push_state_consistency/metadata_consistency resolve NOT_APPLICABLE through this adapter by design (no second independent source exists in RepositoryState). No Repository Skills, no execution, no authorization, no Repository Transition Validator behavior changes, no lifecycle command changes, no Notification Policy changes, no Canonical Artifact Promotion changes, no Push-State Reconciliation changes, no Post-Push Canonicalization changes, no Telegram changes, no REST, no Dashboard, no plugins, no SLM/LLM integration. Execution capability remains unavailable.
tests_added_or_updated: 32 new focused integration tests added (tests/test_repository_transition_validator_decision_evaluation_integration.py); 2 tests updated in tests/test_decision_evaluation.py to reflect the new one-directional dependency; all 36 pre-existing validator tests and all real lifecycle integration tests pass unmodified
